summary: Point release ldflags at the canonical published Go module and Homebrew metadata at the public library directory.
reason: The published module is github.com/mvanhorn/printing-press-library/library/marketing/keyword-planner; the prior ldflag used the local module path and the prior homepage pointed to a nonexistent repository.
validated_outcome: A CLI build with the canonical ldflag and a temporary version ran --version successfully without changing Go source or release versions.
